purpose: Credential audit before first publication to HASHQIX/else-voice-canvas

additionalAssignmentRuleFindings.disposition: Only descriptive test signing values in two temporary-database test suites and synthetic provider placeholders in the production smoke runner. Historical/object hits duplicate the integration fixture. None matches local credentials.

tools.gitleaks: 8.30.1; default rules plus explicit provider/session assignment detection; 100% output redaction; archive depth 3; decode depth 5
tools.exactMatching: Local credential values read in memory and compared against publication candidates, every local Git blob/commit/tag and browser build assets; values never printed or written to reports.
tools.binaryText: Local macOS Vision OCR for 20 PNGs, PDFKit for one PDF, ZIP/XML extraction for one DOCX; extracted text scanned locally.

limitations: Provider variable names and empty configuration templates are expected public source content; the audit checks credential values.
Automated patterns, exact-value matching and OCR do not prove the absence of every possible unknown or visually obscured secret.
No source code, credentials, audio or OCR text was uploaded to an external scanning service.
Final staged content is checked again immediately before the publication commit.
